original_bug_description: Heap-buffer-overflow (out-of-bounds read) in ELF parsing: an 8‑byte read in get_ne64 / BEPolicy::get64 (src/bele.h / src/bele_policy.h), invoked from PackLinuxElf64::PackLinuxElf64help1 (src/p_lx_elf.cpp, seen during PackLinuxElf64ppc construction), can read past the end of an ELF-derived buffer when processing symbol table information. A crafted ELF input can trigger this out‑of‑bounds read, leading to crashes or potential disclosure of memory contents.
